observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same white split-type air conditioner unit, with indoor and outdoor components visible.
The indoor unit has a visible brand name 'DAIKIN' on the lower right corner of the front panel.
The outdoor unit also has 'DAIKIN' branding on its side panel.
The indoor unit has a 'INVERTER' label on the top right corner.
The unit appears to be placed outdoors on a concrete surface, possibly in a storage or sales yard.
There is a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI UNIQUE ITEMS' across both photos.
The unit shows some minor surface dust and dirt, especially on the outdoor unit and lower front panel.
No remote control, power cord, or installation accessories are visible in the photos.
No visible damage or dents on the casing, but the condition cannot be fully assessed without seeing the interior or testing.

claims.claim: Very Clean and reliable A/C in Very perfect working condition
claims.evidence: Photos show surface condition but do not prove internal cleanliness or functionality. No proof of operation is visible.

risks.risk: The unit may not be in working condition despite the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the unit turning on, cooling, and responding to the remote control.

risks.risk: The unit may have internal damage, clogged filters, or refrigerant issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the indoor unit's filter, evaporator coil, and outdoor unit's condenser coil, and a video of the unit running.
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing repair or servicing

risks.risk: The unit may be missing essential components like the remote control, power cord, or installation kit.
risks.proof: Photos showing the remote control, power cord, and any included accessories.

proof_requests: Video of the unit turning on and cooling with the remote control.
Close-up photos of the indoor and outdoor unit's internal components (filters, coils).
Photo of the remote control and power cord if included.
response.reason: The brand is identifiable as Daikin, but the working condition, completeness, and internal condition cannot be verified from the photos alone. The seller's claim of 'perfect working condition' is unverified, and hidden risks such as non-functionality or missing parts affect pricing. Proof of operation and completeness is required before pricing.
